overview_description.description: Rejoy Health operates as an AI-driven healthcare knowledge and wellness platform, offering real-time access to reliable medical information. Its model outperforms other AI systems on benchmarks such as MedQA. The platform supports a wide range of use cases, including topic research, exam preparation, writing patient handouts and home care instructions, exploring relevant labs, and finding evidence-backed medical data. Rejoy Health also provides digital physical therapy using computer vision and motion feedback for guided rehabilitation, and offers video-based educational content on injury prevention, pain relief, and mindful meditation through its “Academy” resource center. The platform supports providers and patients in understanding clinical topics through content summaries, resource links, and AI-generated materials available both via a free, ad-supported tier and a pay-as-you-go, ad-free option.
